artifactClass: PRODUCTION STATIC CLIMATE DATA - NASA POWER PRIMARY

attribution.brandingConstraints: no NASA insignia or logotype; no wording implying NASA endorsement
attribution.displayLine: Climate data source: NASA POWER (NASA Langley Research Center) · Climatology / Daily / Monthly point APIs · 1991–2020 · accessed 2026-09-13
attribution.statement: Climate data source: NASA POWER (NASA Langley Research Center)

daylightHoursPolicy: astronomical computation (UTRIPLA methodology) - not NASA data

extension.method: Same endpoints/params/semantics as the v8.7 pilot pipeline (Daily API T2M_MAX/T2M_MIN/PRECTOTCORR 1991-2020; Climatology T2M/PRECTOTCORR_SUM/WS2M/ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN; r1-r7.v4 tiers; NOAA civil-twilight daylight). Core hashes recomputed over the full record set; v8.7 freeze files untouched.

licence.basis: NASA science-data rights chain: NASA-led data without restrictive notice defaults to CC0 (science.data.nasa.gov/about/license); POWER project declares no restrictions on use/access/download; the only licence label (CC BY 4.0, AWS registry) is permissive. Either branch authorises the production usage pattern.
licence.residual: EU sui generis database right = LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED (jurisdiction-specific, non-blocking)

daylightHours.aggregationMethod: mean over 1991-2020 of the per-year calendar-month mean of daily civil daylight duration (equal year weights; leap years exact; polar night 0.0 h / midnight sun 24.0 h handled)
daylightHours.formulaReference: NOAA General Solar Position Calculations (published methodology, not a data product); formulaVersion noaa-solar-position-2026.09.v1
daylightHours.parameter: solar declination + standard sunrise/sunset hour angle (z0 = 90.833 deg)
daylightHours.selectionReason: v8.6 closes M-1: explicit reproducible implementation adopted; must never be labelled as observed climate data

precipDaysGe1mm.aggregationMethod: UTRIPLA derived statistic (v8.6 authorised): count of daily precipitation >= 1.0 mm (WMO rain-day convention) per calendar month per year, then arithmetic mean over 1991-2020
precipDaysGe1mm.selectionReason: Option A of methodology decision v8.6: deterministic count from the same source family's official daily product; not a proxy, no cross-family mixing; R1-R7 does not consume this field

precipMm.aggregationMethod: 1991-2020 average of the monthly total (accumulated) precipitation
precipMm.selectionReason: accumulated monthly total; PRECTOTCORR (mm/day rate) rejected for precipMm

sunshineHours.aggregationMethod: UNRESOLVED - no production-grade source in the accepted families; canonical value null

tempHighC.aggregationMethod: mean over 1991-2020 of the per-year calendar-month mean of daily maximum temperature
tempHighC.selectionReason: Climatology T2M_MAX_AVG rejected: 30-year average of monthly EXTREME maximum, not mean of daily max

tempLowC.aggregationMethod: mean over 1991-2020 of the per-year calendar-month mean of daily minimum temperature
tempLowC.selectionReason: Climatology T2M_MIN_AVG rejected: 30-year average of monthly EXTREME minimum, not mean of daily min

grid.resolution: NASA/POWER Source Native Resolution (tested: ~0.5 deg lat x 0.625 deg lon)
